# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1998

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 02**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance implementing Supplemental Budget No. 02, S-1998 of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The ordinance appropriates P 563,176.47 (Five Hundred Sixty Three Thousand, One Hundred Seventy Six Pesos and Forty Seven Centavos) and reverts certain amounts intended for the Human Resource Management Officer II and Medical Technologist II back to the general fund. The total amount reverted is P 253,518.47. The ordinance takes effect immediately upon approval and was unanimously approved.

**Total amount appropriated:** P 563,176.47
**Amount reverted to general fund:** P 253,518.47 (from HRMO II and Medical Technologist II positions)

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** The amount of P 563,176.47 is hereby appropriated.
- **Section 2.** The amount of P 95,778.87 intended for the Human Resource Management Officer II and the amount of P 187,739.60 for Medical Technologist II (totaling P 253,518.47) are hereby reverted to the general fund.
- **Section 3.** The Supplemental Budget No. 02, S-1998 and the supporting papers marked as Annex "A" are hereby made an integral part of this ordinance.
- **Section 4.** This Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, S-1998 shall take effect immediately upon approval.
